mentions.name: civilwhiz.com
mentions.description: A blog website dedicated to sharing knowledge about Autodesk Civil 3D, providing deeper explanations of the software's inner workings through written posts rather than video tutorials, which are already widely available elsewhere. It is hosted on WordPress with plugins and involves no coding by the author; it was originally set up to teach the author Civil 3D, with the learning process shared openly so others can benefit.
mentions.problem: Most existing Civil 3D portals lack deeper explanations of the software's inner workings, and video tutorials are already widely available elsewhere.
mentions.audience: Others learning Autodesk Civil 3D who can benefit from the openly shared learning process
mentions.source_excerpt: civilwhiz.com – A website dedicated to sharing knowledge about Autodesk Civil 3D. It’s all about old-fashioned knowledge sharing through blog posts, with absolutely no coding (on my part). I host it via WordPress and use some plugins to make it work.
